向着长白山主峰上行，山路崎岖陡峭，古木遮天蔽日。

越靠近山巅，周遭气场越发压抑，空气中混杂着龙脉散逸的清气与邪煞侵蚀的浊气，两股气息交织冲撞，让人胸闷气沉，道心都隐隐受到扰动。

林间静谧得可怕，听不到鸟兽鸣叫，连虫鸣都彻底绝迹，只剩山风穿过林梢的呜咽，还有山巅隐约不绝的咒诵声，低沉晦涩，钻入耳膜，扰人心神。

众人结成紧凑攻守阵型，缓步上行。

胡九郎走在最前，神识铺展三里山林，天眼俯瞰周遭地气走势，提前预判阵法陷阱、潜行埋伏；范梦雪右侧护法，雷光内敛，随时可引雷破煞；王欣欣、茉沫左右掠阵，目光扫视密林暗处，暗器时刻待命；李安琪殿后，山石灵气萦绕周身，可随时构筑防御壁垒；钱丹袖中蛊虫警醒，感应周遭蛊毒阴气异动；杨瑞手持法牌，灵光流转，加固全队护身结界；林佳冷静记录地形与煞气分布；李二牛押着织田美子，仙家灵感警惕四方。

行至半山腰一片苍莽密林，古树粗壮参天，枝干交错，林下枯枝厚积，视野受限，极易暗藏潜行伏击。

“停。”

胡九郎忽然抬手止步，眸光冷冽扫过整片密林。

“前方林地气场异常，地气紊乱，隐有阵法纹路，是甲贺忍布设的迷影杀阵，已经把我们悄悄圈入阵中了。”

众人瞬间驻足，神色戒备，周身灵气运转，进入临战状态。

李二牛凝神感应片刻，脸色凝重：“俺仙家能察觉到，林子四面八方都藏着忍者气息，数量至少二十人以上，全是中忍、上忍级别，借着古树阴影、阵法迷雾隐匿身形，把咱们团团围死了。”

被封印修为的织田美子嘴角勾起一抹冷笑：“敢往山巅闯，早就给你们备好了葬身之地。甲贺忍的迷影合围阵，擅隐身、幻形、分身、偷袭，就算你们战力再强，陷在阵中也会被慢慢耗死。”

茉沫瞪了她一眼：“少得意，当初黑风岭、西风村，哪一次埋伏不是被我们破了？区区忍阵，照样给你拆得干干净净。”

胡九郎目光平静扫过四周密林，淡淡开口：“迷影杀阵，以古树为桩、以阴影为媒、以幻术为网，擅长隐匿合围、逐个偷袭。寻常修士陷入其中，分不清虚实，极易被分割孤立，逐一斩杀。”

“但此阵有个弱点：怕至阳雷力、怕道门镇阵灵光。范师妹雷法大范围铺开，可破幻术迷雾；我布八卦锁困阵，定住阵眼节点，让他们分身失效、隐匿无用；唐门姐妹守住四方死角，防备近身偷袭；其余人稳住阵型，不要被幻境迷惑。”

指令清晰下达，众人立刻就位。

范梦雪迈步而出，素白道袍迎风舒展，双手结神霄雷印，头顶隐隐有银白电光汇聚，林间空气瞬间变得灼热。

“神霄正法，雷照密林！”

轰隆一声轻鸣，漫天细碎雷光从她周身迸发，如同白昼流光，瞬间洒满整片密林。

Chapter 86: Ambush in the dense forest, siege by the Ninja Formation - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

Heading up to the main peak of Changbai Mountain, the mountain road is rugged and steep, and ancient trees block out the sky and the sun.

The closer you get to the top of the mountain, the more oppressive the surrounding aura becomes. The air is mixed with the clean air dissipated from the dragon veins and the turbid air corroded by evil spirits. The two auras collide with each other, making your chest feel tight and heavy, and your Taoist heart is faintly disturbed.

The forest was eerily quiet, with no chirping of birds or animals, and even the chirping of insects completely extinct. Only the whine of the mountain wind passing through the forest tops, and the faint and endless sound of mantras chanting from the top of the mountain were left, low and obscure, penetrating into the eardrums and disturbing people's minds.

Everyone formed a compact offensive and defensive formation and slowly moved up.

Hu Jiulang walked in the front, his spiritual consciousness spread across the three-mile mountain forest, and his heavenly eyes overlooked the surrounding earth energy trends, predicting formation traps in advance, and sneaking in ambush; Fan Mengxue protected the law on the right, and the thunder light was restrained, and could trigger thunder to break the evil at any time; Wang Xinxin and Momo swept the formation left and right, scanning the dark places of the dense forest, and hidden weapons were always on standby; Li Anqi PalaceAfterwards, the spiritual energy of the mountains and rocks lingers around the body and can build defensive barriers at any time; the poison in Qian Dan's sleeves is alert, sensing the changes in the poisonous Yin energy around him; Yang Rui holds the spell card, and the spiritual light circulates to strengthen the team's protective barrier; Lin Jia calmly records the terrain and the distribution of evil spirits; Li Erniu holds Miko Oda, and the fairy family is alert to all directions.

We reached a vast dense forest halfway up the mountain. The ancient trees were thick and towering, and their branches were intertwined. There were thick piles of dead branches under the forest, and the field of vision was limited, making it easy to hide and ambush.

"Stop."

Hu Jiulang suddenly raised his hand and stopped, his cold eyes sweeping across the entire dense forest.

"The aura of the forest ahead is abnormal, the earth's aura is disordered, and there are hidden formation patterns. It is the shadow killing formation set up by the Koga Ninja, and it has quietly trapped us in the formation."

Everyone stopped instantly, with alert expressions on their faces, and their spiritual energy circulated around them, entering a battle-ready state.

Li Erniu concentrated for a moment, and then said with a solemn expression: "My immortal family can detect that there are ninja auras hidden in all directions in the forest. There are at least twenty people, all at the chuunin and jounin level. They use the shadow of the ancient trees and the fog of the formation to hide their figures, and they surround us."

A sneer appeared at the corner of Miko Oda's lips, who had been sealed. "If you dare to go to the top of the mountain, a burial place has been prepared for you. The Koga Ninja's shadow encirclement formation is good at invisibility, transformation, clones, and sneak attacks. No matter how powerful you are, you will be slowly exhausted if you are trapped in the formation."

Momo glared at her: "Don't be proud, we didn't break any of the ambush in Heifeng Ridge and Xifeng Village back then? Even the mere forbearance formations were completely destroyed by you."

Hu Jiulang's eyes calmly scanned the dense forest around him, and he said calmly: "The shadow-obsessed killing array uses ancient trees as stakes, shadows as mediums, and illusions as nets. It is good at concealing encirclement and sneak attacks one by one. Ordinary monks are trapped in it, unable to distinguish reality from reality, and can easily be separated and isolated, and killed one by one."

"But this formation has a weakness: it is afraid of the thunder power of the Zhiyang and the aura of the Dao Sect's suppression formation. Junior Sister Fan's thunder spells are spread out over a wide area, which can break through the fog of illusions; I set up the Bagua Lock Formation and fix the eye nodes of the formation to make their clones ineffective and invisible; the Tang Sect sisters guard the dead corners in all directions to guard against close sneak attacks; the others stabilize their formation and do not be confused by the illusion."

The order was given clearly and everyone immediately got into position.

Fan Mengxue stepped out, her plain white robe stretched out in the wind, her hands formed with divine thunder seals, and there was a faint silver-white electric light gathering above her head, and the air in the forest instantly became scorching.

"The gods are rectifying the law, and the thunder is shining in the dense forest!"

There was a soft roar, and the sky was filled with tiny thunders bursting out from around her, like daylight, instantly filling the entire dense forest.
